card.title: Here We Go Again
card.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You promised to call. I kept dinner warm until eleven again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was the train. Different explanation, same ruined dinner. Tomorrow I'm eating at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone next time. Please keep a plate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how I end up waiting again. Miss another call and you're buying and cooking your own dinners.

mechanism: A reads another missed call and even a plate-saving request as the recurring waiting pattern and raises the cost of repetition.
confusable: Unlike addressing one late dinner, A must connect each new answer to the same repeated pattern and escalate consequences.
comparison: D96-a moves from eating earlier to separate meal responsibility; D96-b moves from explaining cancellation to arranging the next visit.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
